method: ABC rejection (uniform/log-uniform priors, accept iff all targets within pre-declared tolerance)

config._doc: ABC rejection calibration per collaborative area (YTA) and first-event type. Tolerances are pre-declared here, not tuned after seeing results.

tolerance.curve_abs_pp_rationale: Max absolute error, in percentage points of ALL patients, at each published month 1-5 of Taulukko 4.5 (month 6 is matched exactly by construction). 1.5 pp is inside the half-width of the team's Wilson 95% CIs for the derived first-active-treatment curve (1.1-2.2 pp, csv/lung_derived_first_active_treatment_by_month_yta.csv).
tolerance.quantile_abs_days_rationale: Max absolute error on published Q1/median/Q3 (Taulukko 4.1). 7 days = one week, the step granularity of the THL Ohjaus 21/2016 section 4.1 targets. Taulukko 4.1 and 4.5 describe slightly different populations (4.1: first TREATMENT; 4.5: first EVENT incl. palliative care and death, smoothed by a multistate model), so a perfect joint fit is not expected.

pi0.meaning: probability mass at day 0 (treatment/event recorded on the diagnosis date)

structural_sensitivity._doc: Variant posterior fitted to Taulukko 4.5 curves only (no 4.1 quartiles) with a tighter 0.5 pp curve tolerance; used only to report how much the 4.1-vs-4.5 population difference moves the diagnosis-anchored outputs. Not used for scenario runs.
